# Read dataset and summarize data for each CoupleID

```{r}

## Read data
data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "Combined_dataset_Europe.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Convert as factor
data <- data  |> 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(PetriNumber = as.factor(PetriNumber)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID = as.factor(CoupleID))

##Summarize data for each CoupleID (1053 rows)
merged_data <- data |>
  dplyr::group_by(CoupleID, CrossType, Female, Male, Batch, Block, Year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(sum_eggcount_corr = sum(EggCountCorr),
                   sum_larvacount = sum(LarvaeCount))

## Compute hatch rate for each CoupleID
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(hatchrate = sum_larvacount / sum_eggcount_corr)

```

# Rename couple ids within each cross type from 1 to n not nessesary

```{r}

## Vector of coupleids
vec <- levels(data$CoupleID)

## For each cross type, name coupleID from 1 to n, the number of couples in this crosstype
for (i in levels(data$CrossType)){
  couple_ids <- unique(data$CoupleID[data$CrossType==i])
  vec[levels(data$CoupleID)%in%couple_ids] <- 1:length(couple_ids)
}

data <- data |>
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID_new = CoupleID)
levels(data$CoupleID_new) <- vec

data <- data |>
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID_new2 = as.numeric(CoupleID_new))


```

# Plot distribution of hatch rate not nessesary
```{r}

data <- data |>
  dplyr::mutate(hatch_rate = LarvaeCount / EggCountCorr)
data

## Overall distribution in hatch rate (counts)
p <- data %>%
  #dplyr::filter(EggCountCorr>10)  %>%
  ggplot() + 
  geom_histogram(aes(hatch_rate))
p

## Overall distribution in hatch rate (frequency)
p <- data %>% 
  ggplot()  + 
  geom_histogram(aes(x=hatch_rate, y = after_stat(count / sum(count))), bins = 20) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  ylab("Frequency")
p


## Make plot with max 20 counts per class
p <- p + ggplot2::facet_wrap(~CrossType, nrow = 10, ncol = 10)
p    

#save bar plot
title_plot <- "Distribution_of_hatch_rate.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   p, base_height = 40/cm(1),
                   base_width = 100/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

## Distribution in hatch rate for 20 first coupleids per CrossType
p <- data %>% 
  dplyr::filter(CoupleID_new2<21)  %>%
  ggplot()  + 
  geom_histogram(aes(x=hatch_rate, fill=CoupleID_new), bins = 10) +
  ylab("Frequency")
p

## Make plot with max 20 counts per CrossType
p <- p + ggplot2::facet_wrap(~CrossType, nrow = 10, ncol = 10) + ylim(0, 20)
    

#save bar plot
title_plot <- "Distribution_of_hatch_rate_max20.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   p, base_height = 40/cm(1),
                   base_width = 100/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

```

# Fit one zero-inflated GLMM with merged_data
```{r}

# Subset the data with a single type of cross (with Bal line)
dat <- merged_data[merged_data$Female%in%c("Am", "Bal")&merged_data$Male%in%c("Am", "Bal"), ]

datCrossType <- dat |>
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Sum_eggcount_corr = sum(sum_eggcount_corr),
                   Sum_larvacount = sum(sum_larvacount))|>
  dplyr::mutate(hatchrate = Sum_larvacount / Sum_eggcount_corr)

## Fit null model
m0 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ 1 , data=dat, ziformula=~1 , family=binomial)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m0)
summary(m0)

## Zero-inflated part of the model
unique(predict(m0, type="zprob"))

## Hatch rate
unique(predict(m0, type="conditional"))

## Combined probability (1-prob_no_mating) x hatch rate
unique(predict(m0, type="response"))

## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m0)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m0)$cond)))

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
sum(dat$sum_larvacount)/sum(dat$sum_eggcount_corr)

## cross type effect on hatch rate
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1 + CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~ 1 , family=binomial)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m1)
summary(m1)

## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m1)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m1)$cond)))

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
datCrossType$hatchrate

## cross type effect on hatch rate and mating probability
m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ 1 , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1 + CrossType , family=binomial)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m2)
summary(m2)

## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m2)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m2)$cond)))

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
datCrossType$hatchrate

## cross type effect on hatch rate and mating probability
dat$prop <- dat$sum_larvacount / dat$sum_eggcount_corr
m3 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop~ -1 + CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1 + CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m3)
summary(m3)

## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m3)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m3)$cond)))

## CI estimate
1-p2[2]/p2[3]

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
datCrossType$hatchrate

MuMIn::AICc(m0, m1, m2, m3)
MuMIn::model.sel(m0, m1, m2, m3)

## Compute confidence interval for m3
## Refit model nsim times
b1 <- lme4::bootMer(m3, FUN=extract_model, nsim=500, .progress="txt")
  
## Extract all CIs
confint <- bCI_tab(b=b1)

```

# Fit each zero-inflated GLMM with merged data and account for nonindependence for CoupleID
```{r}
## Example for one cross
AmBal <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "Bal"), data=merged_data)

AmTrento <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "Trento"), data=merged_data)

AmRennes <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "Rennes"), data=merged_data)

AmPar6 <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "L6"), data=merged_data)

## Tetracyclin-treated strains
AmBalT <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "BalT"), data=merged_data)

AmTrentoT <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "TrentoT"), data=merged_data)

## Cl: after tetracycline, still a reduction in hatch rate in BalT and TrentoT, but lower compared to original strains

AmRennesT <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "RennesT"), data=merged_data)

## Introgressed strains
AmAmBal <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "Am^Bal"), data=merged_data)

AmAmTrento <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "Am^Trento"), data=merged_data)

## Cl: Loss of CI in Am^Bal, but maybe not in Am^Trento (no difference between the test cross and one control cross 3)

AmAmRennes <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "Am^Rennes"), data=merged_data)
## Cl: No CI (m2 = best model) 

## Crosses with strains carrying Wolbachia
TrentoBal <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Trento", "Bal"), data=merged_data)
##Cl: no CI of Bal with Trento?

L6Bal <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "L6", "Bal"), data=merged_data)
##Cl: CI of Bal with par6?

## With other reference uninfected strains
MT47Bal<- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "MT47", "Bal"), data=merged_data)

L6Bal<- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "L7", "Bal"), data=merged_data)

L6L7 <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "L7", "L6"), data=merged_data)

```

# Fit all Tetracyclin+introgressed
```{r}

#Filter data for Bal, L6 and Rennes only for Batch 5
merged_data_batch5 <- merged_data |>
 dplyr::filter(Batch == 5)

## List strains from Europe
europe <- unique(merged_data$Male[merged_data$Female=="Am"&merged_data$Male!="Am"])
europe <- europe[c(1, 2, 12, 4)]

## Dataframe with all the strains
crosses <- data.frame(continent=rep("europe", 7), uninf_strain="Am" , inf_strain=c("TrentoT", "BalT", "RennesT", "Am^Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Rennes", "Am^L6"))


## Fit all models on all the crosses function
results <- apply(crosses, 1, fit_ZIBinomial, nbootsim = 100)

#results <- apply(crosses[10,], 1, fit_ZIBinomial)

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)
##crossnum <- 1:2
confintp1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp1"))

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

CI <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintCI"))

## Export files
write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "model_AICc_Tet_Introgr.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

write.table(x = confintp1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp1_Tet_Introgr.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_Tet_Introgr.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = CI, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CI_estimates_Tet_Introgr.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Fit zero-inflated GLMM with for introgressed lines Am^Bal, Am^Trento, Am^Par6 and Am^Rennes

```{r}

#Fit all zero-inflated models for introgression experiment for Batch6 and Batch 7 only
##Filter data for Bal, L6 and Rennes only for Batch 6 nad 7
merged_data_batch67 <- merged_data |>
 dplyr::filter(Batch == 6 | Batch == 7)

## Dataframe with all the strains
crosses <- data.frame(continent=rep("europe", 8), uninf_strain="Am" , inf_strain=c("Trento", "Bal", "Rennes", "Par6", "Am^Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Rennes", "Am^Par6"))

results <- apply(crosses, 1,
  function(x) {
    fit_ZIBinomial(
      crosses = x,
      data = merged_data_batch67,
      nbootsim = 100)})

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_intr_Batch67.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "model_AICc_intr_Batch67.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

#Read database with hatch rate and CI
datai <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_intr_Batch67.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

#Remove rows for "Am^Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Rennes", "Am^Par6"
datai<- datai |>
dplyr::filter(!infstrain %in% c("Am^Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Rennes", "Am^Par6"))

# Fit model m1 for Am^Trento
dat <- merged_data_batch67 |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Female %in% c("Am", "Am^Trento"),
      Male %in% c("Am", "Am^Trento"))

res_trento <- run_hatchrate_ci(
  data = merged_data_batch67,
  uninfstrain = "Am",
  infstrain = "Am^Trento",
  nsim = 100,
  model = "m1",
  seed = 1
)

attr(res_trento, "p2")
attr(res_trento, "model")

# Fit model m1 for Am^Bal

dat <- merged_data_batch67 |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Female %in% c("Am", "Am^Bal"),
      Male %in% c("Am", "Am^Bal"))

res_bal <- run_hatchrate_ci(
  data = merged_data_batch67,
  uninfstrain = "Am",
  infstrain = "Am^Bal",
  nsim = 100,
  model = "m1",
  seed = 1
)

attr(res_bal, "p2")
attr(res_bal, "model")

# Fit model m1 for Am^Rennes

dat <- merged_data_batch67 |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Female %in% c("Am", "Am^Rennes"),
      Male %in% c("Am", "Am^Rennes"))

res_ren <- run_hatchrate_ci(
  data = merged_data_batch67,
  uninfstrain = "Am",
  infstrain = "Am^Rennes",
  nsim = 100,
  model = "m1",
  seed = 1
)

attr(res_bal, "p2")
attr(res_bal, "model")

# Fit model m1 for Am^Par6

dat <- merged_data_batch67 |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Female %in% c("Am", "Am^Par6"),
      Male %in% c("Am", "Am^Par6"))

res_par <- run_hatchrate_ci(
  data = merged_data_batch67,
  uninfstrain = "Am",
  infstrain = "Am^Par6",
  nsim = 100,
  model = "m1",
  seed = 1
)

attr(res_bal, "p2")
attr(res_bal, "model")

datai2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(datai, res_trento, res_bal, res_ren, res_par)

 
#Save full dataset for experiment with introgressed lines
write.table(x = datai2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_intr_Batch_67_full.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

```

# Fit all infected x infected

# Fit all worldwide
```{r}
## List strains from Europe
europe <- unique(merged_data$Male[merged_data$Female=="Am"&merged_data$Male!="Am"])
europe <- europe[c(1, 2, 12, 4)]

## List strains from USA
usa1 <- unique(merged_data$Male[merged_data$Female=="Sok80"&merged_data$Male!="Sok80"])
usa2 <-  unique(merged_data$Male[merged_data$Female=="W120"&merged_data$Male!="W120"])
usa1 <- usa1[c(2, 1)]

## List strains from Asia
asia <- unique(merged_data$Male[merged_data$Female=="T18"&merged_data$Male!="T18"])
asia <- asia[c(5, 4, 6, 1, 2)]

## Dataframe with all the strains
crosses <- data.frame(continent=c(rep("Europe", length(europe)), rep("USA", length(usa1)), rep("USA", length(usa2)), rep("Asia", length(asia))), uninf_strain = c(rep("Am", length(europe)), rep("Sok80", length(usa1)), rep("W120", length(usa2)), rep("T18", length(asia))), inf_strain= c(europe, usa1, usa2, asia))

## Fit all models on all the crosses function
results <- apply(crosses, 1, fit_ZIBinomial, nbootsim=100)
#results <- apply(crosses[10,], 1, fit_ZIBinomial)

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)
##crossnum <- 1:2
confintp1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp1"))

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

CI <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintCI"))

## Export files
write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "model_AICc_Batch.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

write.table(x = confintp1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp1_Batch.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_Batch.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = CI, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CI_estimates_Batch.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Model checking
```{r, eval=FALSE}
m3_simres <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m3)
plot(m3_simres)

car::Anova(m3,type="III")

## Confidence interval for p1 and p2
1/(1+exp(-confint(m3, parm=NULL, estimate = TRUE, component="all", method="Wald")))

## Confidence interval for p1
emmeans::emmeans(m3, ~ CrossType, component = "zi", type = "response")

## Confidence interval for p2
emmp2 <- emmeans::emmeans(m3, ~ CrossType, component = "cond", type = "response")

## Confidence interval for (1-p1)*p2
emmeans::emmeans(m3, ~ CrossType, component = "response")

pairs(emmp2, adjust = "tukey")
(1-p2[2])/(1-p2[1])
coefp2 <- glmmTMB::fixef(m3)$cond
exp(coefp2[1]-coefp2[2])

```

# Fit zero-inflated GLMM without merged data (not for publication)
```{r}
## TODO: - Add flip (or male age) to the model 
##       - Add number of eggs to the model (ie test for trade off between quantity and quality)

# Subset the data with a single type of cross
dat <- data[data$Female%in%c("Am", "Bal")&data$Male%in%c("Am", "Bal"), ]
dim(dat)
#dat <- data[data$Female%in%c("Am", "Trento")&data$Male%in%c("Am", "Trento"), ]
#dat <- data[data$Female%in%c("Am", "Rennes")&data$Male%in%c("Am", "Rennes"), ]
#dat <- data[data$Female%in%c("Am", "L6")&data$Male%in%c("Am", "L6"), ]

#dat <- data[data$CrossType=="AmxL6", ]
#dat <- data[data$CrossType=="W120xW120", ]
#dat <- data[data$CrossType=="W148xW120", ]
#dat <- data[data$CrossType=="Sok28xSok28", ]
#dat[dat$LarvaeCount==0&dat$CrossType=="TrentoxTrento",]

dat %>%
  dplyr::mutate(hatch_rate=LarvaeCount/EggCountCorr) |>
  #dplyr::group_by(CoupleID, CrossType, Female, Male, Batch, Block, Year) |>
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType, Female, Male) |>
  dplyr::summarize(sample_size=dplyr::n(), mean_hatch_rate=mean(hatch_rate), median_hatch_rate=median(hatch_rate))


## Fit null model
m0 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr-LarvaeCount) ~ 1 + (1|CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~1 + (1|CoupleID), family=binomial)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m0)
summary(m0)

## Zero-inflated part of the model
unique(predict(m0, type="zprob"))

## Hatch rate
unique(predict(m0, type="conditional"))

## Combined probability (1-prob_no_mating) x hatch rate
unique(predict(m0, type="response"))

## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m0)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m0)$cond)))

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
sum(dat$LarvaeCount)/sum(dat$EggCountCorr)

## cross type effect on hatch rate
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr-LarvaeCount) ~ -1 + CrossType + (1|CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~ 1 + (1|CoupleID), family=binomial)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m1)
summary(m1)

## Probability of having no mating
p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m1)$zi))

## Hatch rate
p2 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m1)$cond))

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
datCrossType$hatchrate

## cross type effect on hatch rate and mating rate (= complete CI?)
m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr-LarvaeCount) ~ 1 + CrossType + (1|CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~ 1 + CrossType + (1|CoupleID), family=binomial)

## Check the model
#glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m2)
summary(m2)

## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m2)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m2)$cond)))

## Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
datCrossType$hatchrate

MuMIn::AICc(m0, m1, m2)

glmmTMB::ranef(m2)$cond$CoupleID


## cross type effect on hatch rate and mating probability
m3 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr-LarvaeCount) ~ -1 + CrossType + (1|CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~ -1 + CrossType + (1|CoupleID), family=binomial)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m3)
summary(m3)

## Probability of having no mating
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m3)$zi)))

## Hatch rate
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m3)$cond)))

## CI estimate
1-p2[2]/p2[3]

##Fitted probability of not dying
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed probability of not dying
datCrossType$hatchrate

MuMIn::AICc(m0, m1, m2, m3)
MuMIn::model.sel(m0, m1, m2, m3)

```

# Old code
```{r, eval=FALSE}

##  Simulate new datasets from the fitted model, and calculate residuals by comparing the observed data to the new data
## residuals are calculated conditional on all random effects using re.form = NULL  
simulationOutput <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(fittedModel = m2, refit = FALSE, re.form = NULL, seed = 12, n = 1000)

## We expect the distribution of residuals to be uniform
hist(residuals(simulationOutput))

## qq-plot to detect overall deviations from the expected distribution
DHARMa::plotQQunif(simulationOutput)

## Plot of the residuals against the predicted value (regression of the empirical 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75 quantiles)
DHARMa::plotResiduals(simulationOutput)

## Test for overdispersion
DHARMa::testDispersion(simulationOutput, type = c("DHARMa", "PearsonChisq"))

## Test for zero-inflation
DHARMa::testZeroInflation(simulationOutput)

# often useful to test dispersion per group (in particular for binomial data, see vignette)
simulationOutputAggregated = DHARMa::recalculateResiduals(simulationOutput, group = data$CrossType)
DHARMa::testDispersion(simulationOutputAggregated)

m3 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
  cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr) ~ 1 + Flip + (1 | CoupleID), 
  data = dat, 
  ziformula = ~ -1 + CrossType, 
  family = binomial
)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m3)
summary(m3)

```
